parts.text: Which claim correctly explains firmness, green colour, and food-making in these plant cells?

options.text: The cell wall gives firmness; chloroplasts contain chlorophyll that makes the leaf green and helps photosynthesis.
The cell membrane gives the potato cell its firmness and rigidity.
Chloroplasts can make food by photosynthesis even without chlorophyll.
Every plastid in every part of the neem plant carries out photosynthesis.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Navya studies a potato cell and a neem leaf cell. The potato cell feels firm. The neem leaf looks green and can make food in sunlight.

part_answers.answer: The cell wall provides rigidity; chlorophyll in chloroplasts makes leaves green and is needed for photosynthesis.

teacher.key_rationale: Plant cell walls give firmness. Chloroplasts hold chlorophyll for green colour and photosynthesis. Membrane alone does not give rigidity; chlorophyll is required; not every plastid photosynthesizes.
